## Description

Briefly describe the purpose of this PR and what changes it introduces.

## Type of Change (Conventional Commits)

- [ ] `feat`: A new feature or pipeline capability
- [ ] `fix`: A bug fix or patch
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring with no functional change
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvements
- [ ] `test`: Test suite updates
- [ ] `chore`: Build system, tooling, or dependency updates

## Related Issues

Closes # (issue number, if applicable)

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits specification (e.g. `feat: ...`, `fix: ...`)
- [ ] Code comments and docstrings are written in English
- [ ] `GEMINI.md`/`AGENTS.md` updated if architectural decisions changed
- [ ] `README.md` updated
- [ ] All tests pass cleanly
